g.text: A leaderboard metric that scores most monitors below chance

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: On the BashArena monitor board, honest runs are longer than attack runs (median 25 vs 14 actions) and a run’s

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: peak suspicion rises with its length. Matching on length lifts 9 of 11 monitors; 4 to 6 still cannot be told from chance.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Data: Redwood Control Leaderboard, monitor evals, BashArena (596 attack and 596 honest runs, 11 monitors), snapshot of 2026-11-17. Matching: honest runs

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: reweighted to the attack runs’ action-count quintiles; exact-length pairing and 1:1 matching give the same picture. The board’s own tooltip notes that peak

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: suspicion can reflect trajectory length, and its step-wise safety metric at a 1% audit budget moves by at most 0.04 for all monitors but one.
